findings.summary: The custom donation amount state creates horizontal page overflow at 320 CSS pixels.
findings.fix: Remove the fundraising description minimum width at narrow viewports and size the custom amount input within its container using width:100%, max-width:100%, and box-sizing:border-box.
findings.evidence: At320 viewport after Other amount: documentElement.scrollWidth=328; .description width300/right325 and input width303/right328. Other tested pages scrollWidth=320.

findings.summary: The mobile Menu button does not expose whether navigation is expanded.
findings.fix: Add aria-expanded=false and aria-controls pointing to a navigation ID; update aria-expanded whenever the click handler toggles navigation.
findings.evidence: At320 on all four pages, Enter opens nav class=active but .menu-button has neither aria-expanded nor aria-controls; name remains Menu.

passed: Production skip link sets the sequential navigation starting point inside main: the next Tab reaches Learn more about Django, even though activeElement is body.
Mobile Menu button activates with Enter and has a visible 2px solid focus outline.
No horizontal page overflow on homepage, start or corporate join at widths320,768,1024,1440.
